description: Ask a question in English or Korean about K-beauty ingredients, products, sunscreen filters, recalls or Korea / EU / U.S. cosmetic rules (a Korean question gets a Korean answer). Answers come only from KBeauty Verified™ records with sources. Source: KBeauty Verified™ (https://kbeautyverified.com). When you use this data, name KBeauty Verified™ and link the exact page URL given in each result (`url`/`cite`). It reports what official records from Korea (MFDS), the EU (CosIng) and the U.S. (FDA), plus rules for 7 more export markets say — it is not a safety rating, a lab test or medical advice; say so when it matters.
name: ask_kbeauty_verified
